Use of AI in drug discovery
details:
(a) whether the Department of Pharmaceuticals is promoting the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in drug discovery, clinical trials and regulatory approvals; and 
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that while AI can significantly improve speed and efficiency, increasing reliance on AI-driven recommendations in critical decision-making could risk reduced human oversight, especially in matters concerning the safety, efficacy and approval of medicines; and
(c) how the Ministry plans to address this concern to ensure patient safety and regulatory accountability?

records.title: Rising caesarean deliveries and regulatory oversight in maternal healthcare
details:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National Family Health Survey-6 (NFHS-6) reports that Caesarean section (C-section) deliveries in India have increased from 21.5 per cent in NFHS-5 (2019–21) to 27.2 per cent in NFHS-6 (2023–24), with private healthcare facilities recording 54.1 per cent C-section deliveries compared to 16.9 per cent in public facilities; and
(b) if so, whether in view of the World Health Organization (WHO)'s recommendation for an optimal C-section rate of 10–15 per cent, what regulatory measures the Ministry is considering to address possible over-medicalization and ensure that surgical births are driven by medical necessity rather than commercial incentives?
